text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That was quite the mean schedule of
races, but
summer camp ended with no
hiccups!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Considering how much I've run, haven't I
gone
way over 3,600 meters?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A-aren't I too talented for my own
good?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: However, I cannot loiter around like this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will run all the way to the beach and
back to put
in even more meters!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Panicking, I trail after Sakura Bakushin
O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Well, I must put a hold to my
running then!
Class representatives
cannot be tardy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I will turn back at once, whoaa?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, my speed has backfired on me!
Trainer,
you're completely soaked!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so Sakura Bakushin O's passionate
(?)
summer camp comes to a close.
